og.alt: Router: Every navigation runs your guards. The Back button too. 885× faster route matching than React Router, and up to 3,763× (8 routers, 1,344-cell correctness gate before timing)

hero.alt: The address bar changes from / to /user/42. The route /user/:id matches, its beforeEnter guard passes, its loader runs, and the view renders with useParams() typed as { id: string } holding '42' and its loader data ready. Then the address returns to / and the home route renders.
